contract: assert a Faraday::Adapter::Test stub matching path and query serves the whole connection with no socket
assert a query the stub declared has to match exactly, while a parameter it did not name is ignored and a stub with no query matches every query
assert an unmatched request raises Faraday::Adapter::Test::Stubs::NotFound naming the URL
assert the host from the connection url_prefix reaches the matcher, so a stub written for another host does not match
assert a 500 without raise_error is only a response, and with raise_error is a Faraday::ServerError
assert middleware order decides whether the raised error carries a parsed or a raw body
assert raise_error maps a 404 to Faraday::ResourceNotFound
assert a JSON body stays a String until the json middleware is added, and then only on a JSON content type
assert verify_stubbed_calls raises on a stub that went unused, while a consumed stub still answers a repeat call
assert the test adapter and the json and raise_error middleware ship inside faraday itself
assert the default net_http adapter is a separate gem, an unregistered adapter fails at lookup, and the default adapter really opens a socket
assert no json gem is resolved into the bundle, because faraday 2.11 parses with the json Ruby ships
case.goal: Test Faraday code against stubbed HTTP with no network, and work out which parts of Faraday 2 still need an extra gem
